objective: Confirm on unused seeds that broad-RFF winner plus unbounded SAVE+RFF filling improves the mean quality of a five-backbone shortlist over broad RFF while preserving winner and opportunity safety.

reference_heads.envelope: Maximum held-out R2 across the four frozen nested-tuned head families.

shared_execution.folds: One four-fold shuffled KFold partition per panel, shared across every candidate and geometry; random_state equals panel seed.
shared_execution.training_only: Geometry transforms, target scaling, and feature/target kernel base bandwidths are fit on training-fold rows only.

kernel_alignment.feature_kernel: Equal arithmetic mixture of Gaussian RBF Gram matrices in the fitted feature geometry.
kernel_alignment.target_kernel: Equal arithmetic mixture of Gaussian RBF Gram matrices on the training-scaled scalar target.
kernel_alignment.base_bandwidth: Median strictly positive pairwise squared distance on training-fold values.

methods.unbounded_winner_fill: Preserve the complete maximum broad-RFF rank group; rank every remaining candidate by SAVE+RFF rank groups

ties.winner_group: The complete maximum broad-RFF group remains tied first.
ties.shortlist_cutoff: Uniformly average all top-k subsets admitted by a rank-group tie.

bootstrap.unit: seed panel within equal-weight target family
bootstrap.pairing: Every contrast preserves seed and family.

decision_rule.primary: upper95 candidate-minus-broad top5 mean utility regret < 0
safety: maximum absolute panel top1 regret difference from broad_rff <= 1e-12
maximum family-mean candidate-minus-broad top5 mean utility regret <= 0.03
all panel metrics complete and finite
decision_rule.pass: Every primary and safety criterion must pass.

runtime: Descriptive only. Winner-fill is conservatively charged the sum of separately evaluated broad-RFF and SAVE+RFF component wall times.
scope: Unused-seed synthetic confirmation of a five-backbone shortlist utility. A pass supports shared-computation and real-panel validation but does not authorize public integration.
